title: #466 AI for Teaching
prompt: Artificial intelligence is good in the teaching field. To what extent do you agree with this?

promptSegments.text: Artificial intelligence is good in the teaching field.
To what extent do you agree with this?

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.

promptTraps.en: Do not merely rephrase the topic without stating a definitive personal position in both intro and conclusion.
